aboutTagline: A senior full stack developer who builds enterprise backends, integrations and open source desktop software.
aboutBackgroundP1: I'm Leandro Rodrigues, a Senior Full Stack Developer in Brasília with more than five years of experience building enterprise software, mostly in Java and Spring Boot. Today I work at Stefanini on APIs and microservices for CASSI, the health plan of Banco do Brasil employees, including an API proxy whose routes live in a database and integrations with third-party scheduling platforms.
aboutBackgroundP2: From March 2022 to November 2024 I worked at QW Software on QWControl, a commercial workload automation platform that competes with Control-M. I led the move from a single codebase to independent modules and plugins, wrote more than 50 integration plugins (SAP, NetBackup, SQL databases, z/OS) and built the VMware dashboard and the Rule Flow editor.
aboutBackgroundP3: I have also done contract work. At DATASUS I helped modernize the backend of RNDS, the national health data network: services moved to Java 21 and Spring Boot 3.5, GraalVM native images tested in staging, and the configuration server removed. At DataCore I built Spring Batch pipelines that turn billing files into PDF, e-mail and SMS notifications for telecom operators.
aboutBackgroundP4: Outside work I build LuminusOS, an immutable GNOME desktop based on Fedora bootc. I build its image, write Aurora Shell, its GNOME Shell extension, and adapted a swap daemon to a read-only root. I also build Aetheris, a native Kubernetes client for the GNOME desktop, in Rust. In open source, I have a pull request under review that adds embedded Wayland windows to CEF, Android support merged into libmem, and OpenCode plugins for OAuth login with model providers.
aboutBackgroundP5: I use Claude Code and Codex in my development workflow, and the commits of the CEF patch say so in an Assisted-by trailer. Client and employer code is not mine to publish, so the Work pages stay at the level of components and flows, and the QWControl screenshots show the real interface running on fake data.
aboutBackgroundP6: A bit of background: I have been programming since I was 11. I started by making Transformice servers in Python, and kept tinkering with server infrastructure along the way: Hamachi networks, a Windows Server 2008 VPS, SQLite databases, Habbo and Club Penguin servers, and more.
